The '''Droid Engineer's Cave''' was a cave located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lok/Legends|Lok]], in the center of one of its volcanoes.

==History==
{{Quote|There are three locations at which we believe you might find prisoner transfer orders for Dr. Bledsoe. These three locations are the Woolamander Palace on Yavin IV, the Rogue CorSec base on Corellia, and the Droid Engineer cave on Lok.|Colonel Darkstone, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:CD" />}}
[[File:Inside_the_droid_cave.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Droids inside the cave.]]
The Droid Engineer's Cave was a cavern network located in the heart of the [[Mount Chaolt]] volcano.<ref name="SWG:DEC" /> As the name implied, was the home of an eccentric [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]],<ref name="SWG:CD" /> the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Sardeya Elgrin]].<ref name="SWG:BBP" /> She used the cave to perform lawless experiments that would not allowed on any of the more civilized worlds.<ref name="SWG:DEC" /> The engineer was experimenting to improve the droid lethal capacities.<ref name="SWG:CD" /> She possessed various droids such as [[IG-series/Legends|IG assassin droids]] and [[Droideka/Legends|Droidekas]].<ref name="SWG:DEC" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] was suspected to have used the caverns presumably as a base, although even the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Darkstone]] was at a loss as to what their exact activities and connection to the caverns were. This acted as the reason it was singled out as one of three possible locations of a prison transfer log that Colonel Darkstone dispatched an Imperial unit to retrieve in an attempt to rescue [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Bledsoe]], the others being the [[Palace of the Woolamander]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] and the [[Mokk Stronghold]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].<ref name="SWG:CD" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the outcast [[Andria E'liyha]] tried to convince a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to attack the cave in order to kill the insane engineer and remove insanity from Lok.<ref name="SWG:AE">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|Andria E'liyha|Lok}}</ref> Later, a spacer working with the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] and [[Balfur Jhcor]] killed the droid engineer Sardeya Elgrin in the cave.<ref name="SWG:BBP" />

The same year, a spacer fought several droids and collected a [[Massassi knuckler]] in the cave.<ref name="SWG:RMWMII">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Rare Melee Weapons Mark II}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Droid Engineer's Cave was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DEC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
